extension.description: Standalone Chaturbate Kodi addon with priority-based TV mode, local favorites, and HLS playback through a localhost rewriting proxy.
extension.news: 0.4.0 - Phase 4a: localhost HLS rewriting proxy (MVP). Master playlist absolutize+rewrite, iPad UA + Referer header injection, dynamic 127.0.0.1 port. Stream playback hookup lands in 0.4.1. 0.3.1 - Fix [COLOR] tags: Kodi requires 8-char AARRGGBB hex; bare 6-char rendered Female/Male/Couple/Trans labels and model names blank. 0.3.0 - Switch browse to Chaturbates JSON API (room-list endpoint). Drops HTML scraping entirely. 0.2.1 - Polish: full-bleed fanart, provider-name fix. 0.2.0 - Phase 2: browse menus (Top, New, Female, Male, Couple, Trans, Search), local favorites, migration tool.
